title: validation_report.json
description: Phase 3 dataset validation output describing quality assessment, structural issues, and readiness status
consumers: Phase 4 - Preprocessing Pipeline (decides how to fix issues)

target_validation._comment: Produced by: Phase 3 Target Validator. Consumed by: Phase 4 (confirms target), Phase 9 (verifies binary classification)

schema_validation._comment: Produced by: Phase 3 Schema Validator. Consumed by: Phase 4 (verifies data types before normalization)

missing_values._comment: Produced by: Phase 3 Missing Data Analyzer. Consumed by: Phase 4 (decides imputation strategy - median/mean/KNN)

duplicates._comment: Produced by: Phase 3 Duplicate Analyzer. Consumed by: Phase 4 (decides whether to drop/keep duplicates)

class_balance._comment: Produced by: Phase 3 Class Balance Analyzer. Consumed by: Phase 4 (decides balancing - class_weight/SMOTE/threshold), Phase 10 (stratified CV)

value_validation._comment: Produced by: Phase 3 Range/Value Validator. Consumed by: Phase 4 (decides outlier treatment)

outliers._comment: Produced by: Phase 3 Outlier Analyzer (IQR/z-score). Consumed by: Phase 4 (decides clipping/removal/keep)

leakage._comment: Produced by: Phase 3 Leakage Analyzer. Consumed by: Phase 4 (excludes identifier columns), Phase 10 (prevents training on leaked features)

patient_level_split_risk._comment: Produced by: Phase 3 Patient Split Analyzer. Consumed by: Phase 4/Phase 10 (determines stratified vs patient-grouped split)

image_label_validation._comment: Only populated for image datasets. Produced by: Phase 3 Image/Label Validator. Consumed by: Phase 4 (verifies alignment)

info_messages.message: 47 potential statistical outliers detected across 3 columns

recommended_preprocessing_steps: Consider class balancing strategy (e.g., class_weight, SMOTE, threshold adjustment)
Outlier treatment optional - medical context required

missing_values._comment: Zero-coded missing values in Glucose, BloodPressure, SkinThickness, Insulin, BMI — biologically impossible zeros treated as missing

patient_level_split_risk.recommendation: Use GroupShuffleSplit on 'name' column — multiple recordings per subject. Standard random split would leak patient data across train/test.

warnings.message: Multiple recordings per subject detected — use grouped split

field_definitions.quality_score: integer 0-100 (clamped, never negative): Technical readiness score NOT medical quality. Start at 100, subtract: 5 per LOW, 10 per MODERATE, 20 per HIGH, 40 per CRITICAL. Apply max(0, score).
field_definitions.target_validation.is_identifier_risk: boolean: Whether column behaves like identifier (patient_id) rather than target
field_definitions.missing_values.severity: enum: PASS (0%) | LOW (0-5%) | MODERATE (5-20%) | HIGH (>20%) — configurable thresholds
field_definitions.class_balance.severity: enum: BALANCED (ratio < 1.5) | MODERATE (1.5-3.0) | HIGH (3.0-10.0) | EXTREME (>10.0) — DECISION 2026-09-10: canonical enum, replaces old 'PASS' for balanced case
field_definitions.value_validation.potential_outlier_count: integer: Statistical outliers that MAY be valid measurements — never auto-delete
field_definitions.leakage.identifier_candidates: array of strings: Column names like 'id', 'name', 'patient_id' to exclude from features
field_definitions.patient_level_split_risk.detected: boolean: Whether multiple samples per patient exist — requires GroupShuffleSplit
field_definitions.critical_issues: array: Issues that set validation_status=BLOCKED (target missing, corrupted dataset, no usable labels)
field_definitions.warnings: array of {code, message, severity, column}: Issues that allow progression but require preprocessing decisions in Phase 4
field_definitions.recommended_preprocessing_steps: array of strings: Suggestions for Phase 4 — Phase 3 does NOT execute these

notes: Phase 3 DETECTS problems but does NOT FIX them - Phase 4 owns transformation decisions
validation_status=BLOCKED prevents progression to Phase 4 until critical issues resolved
quality_score is technical readiness, NOT medical quality assessment
Outlier detection distinguishes structural invalidity (age=-17) from statistical outliers (cholesterol=350)
For medical datasets, patient-level split detection prevents train/test leakage
Identifier columns (patient_id) flagged for exclusion from feature set
Thresholds (0-5% LOW, 5-20% MODERATE, >20% HIGH) are configurable engineering categories
Phase 3 → Phase 4 handoff: dataset_id + dataset_profile + validation_report
